title: Your music offline
body: Home and search show downloaded songs when offline, and offline playback skips unavailable songs. Likes, playlists and history remain saved locally. Download requests wait across restarts for an allowed connection; Wi-Fi only is the default and Data Saver takes precedence.

title: A fresh catch, every update
body: Pufferfish now shows version-specific release notes after an update.

title: Available offline
body: Reopen these notes from Settings without downloading anything.
